# Online Courses Club

> > Premium online courses for game development, 3D modeling, motion graphics, and digital art using industry-standard tools like Unreal Engine, Unity, Maya, 3ds Max, After Effects, and Photoshop.

Online Courses Club provides comprehensive tutorials and training across game development, 3D animation, motion graphics, and digital design. Courses cover tools from Epic Games, Autodesk, Adobe, and other leading software publishers, ranging from beginner guides to advanced production techniques.

## Key Topics

- Unreal Engine 4
- Unity
- After Effects
- Photoshop
- Maya
- 3ds Max
- Blueprint visual scripting
- Game development
- 3D modeling
- Motion graphics
- Digital painting
- Compositing
- Special effects
- Intermediate tutorials
- Beginner guides

## Game Development & Game Engines

- [Unreal Engine 4: The Complete Beginner's Course](https://online-courses.club/unreal-engine-4-the-complete-beginners-course-packt-publishing): Unreal Engine 4 beginner course by Packt with Blueprint scripting
- [Unreal Blueprint](https://online-courses.club/unreal-blueprint): Unreal Blueprint visual scripting intermediate course by Scott Pagano
- [Make a Katamari Damacy Style Game in Unity](https://online-courses.club/make-a-katamari-damacy-style-game-in-unity-udemy): Unity C# Katamari Damacy clone game development tutorial
- [Texturing a Game Asset in Blender](https://online-courses.club/texturing-a-game-asset-in-blender): Blender texture painting for Unity game assets by Darrin Lile
- [Creating a Environment Kit Design for Games](https://online-courses.club/creating-a-environment-kit-design-for-games): 3ds Max modular game environment design with UV mapping tutorial
- [Learn 2D Game Special Effect Animation in Photoshop](https://online-courses.club/learn-2d-game-special-effect-animation-in-photoshop): Photoshop 2D game sprite special effects by Jaysen Batchelor

## Motion Graphics & Visual Effects

- [After Effects CC 2019 Essential Training - The Basics](https://online-courses.club/after-effects-cc-2019-essential-training-the-basics): After Effects CC 2019 beginner essentials by Mark Christiansen
- [After Effects Guru- Plugins You Should Know](https://online-courses.club/after-effects-guru-plugins-you-should-know): After Effects plugins guide featuring BCC 10 and mocha by Nick Harauz
- [After Effects Compositing Animation from Animate CC](https://online-courses.club/after-effects-compositing-animation-from-animate-cc): After Effects compositing workflow with Animate CC by Dermot O'Connor
- [Motion Design in After Effects - Character Animation & Coin Flip](https://online-courses.club/motion-design-in-after-effects-character-animation-coin-flip): After Effects character animation and looping GIF by JD McNeil

## 3D Modeling & Animation

- [Animating Cartoon Characters in Maya](https://online-courses.club/animating-cartoon-characters-in-maya): Maya cartoon character animation with rigging and walk cycles by Maestri
- [Creating a Female Hairstyle for Production](https://online-courses.club/creating-a-female-hairstyle-for-production): Maya XGen hair grooming with Arnold rendering for production
- [Dreadnought Modeling Volume 2](https://online-courses.club/dreadnought-modeling-volume-2-3dmotive): 3DS Max hard surface dreadnought modeling by 3DMotive
- [Shading and Texturing Interior Architecture with Substance Painter and V-Ray for 3ds Max](https://online-courses.club/shading-and-texturing-interior-architecture-with-substance-painter-and-v-ray-for-3ds-max): Substance Painter and V-Ray architectural texturing workflow

## Digital Art & Graphic Design

- [Illustrator CC 2018 One-on-One Advanced](https://online-courses.club/illustrator-cc-2018-one-on-one-advanced): Illustrator CC 2018 advanced vector drawing by Deke McClelland
- [Mastering Digital Art Basics to Final portrait](https://online-courses.club/mastering-digital-art-basics-to-final-portrait): Digital portrait painting basics to advanced by Chloe Rose
- [T-shirt design with Photoshop](https://online-courses.club/t-shirt-design-with-photoshop): Photoshop CC t-shirt graphic design intermediate course by Gary Ajene
- [How to Master Double Exposure in Photoshop](https://online-courses.club/how-to-master-double-exposure-in-photoshop): Photoshop double exposure with blending modes by Aaron Nace
- [Create Photoshop Brushes from Absolutely Anything](https://online-courses.club/create-photoshop-brushes-from-absolutely-anything): Photoshop custom brush creation beginner tutorial by Emma Bryan

## Architecture & Interior Design

- [Revit Interior Design Construction Ready Techniques](https://online-courses.club/revit-interior-design-construction-ready-techniques): Revit BIM interior design with construction documentation techniques
